obligations.title: Organization, legal, business-day, and operations settings
obligations.scope: Implement tenant settings for organization/legal profile, locale/timezone, tax/document profile, business day, service windows, cutoffs, holidays, operational minimums, and effective policy revisions.

obligations.title: Team, access, security, and personal-preference settings
obligations.scope: Build all team invite/role/suspend/remove/ownership-transfer/session-revoke controls and separate tenant policy from individual locale, notification, accessibility, default-view, and saved-filter preferences.

obligations.title: Automation, geography, fulfilment, and app-policy settings
obligations.scope: Configure automation grants, budgets, notification escalation, zones, routes, trucks, inventory policy, delivery evidence policy, and per-user application behavior as separate revisioned settings domains.

obligations.title: Plan, subscription billing, invoices, and restricted-state controls
obligations.scope: Implement Rocoto subscription plan, seat/usage state, billing contact, payment-method portal request, invoices, cancellation/reactivation, and policy-defined restricted access independently from customer receivables.

obligations.title: Data administration, privacy requests, retention, and legal hold
obligations.scope: Operate tenant data inventory, retention, export-all, access report, rectification, redaction/delete request, legal hold, recovery window, and support approval as auditable policy-controlled jobs.

obligations.title: Administration navigation, setting inventory, and controlled founder operations
obligations.scope: Make all administration sections and their control inventories reachable, scope-correct, searchable, and auditable, including approved tenant provisioning and operational overview for authorized operators.

obligations.title: Asynchronous job orchestration, retries, and dead letters
obligations.scope: Provide the tenant-safe durable job backbone for imports, exports, rendering, sync, intelligence, scans, image work, data lifecycle, retries, cancellation, reconciliation, and manual recovery.

obligations.title: Operational observability, alerts, and incident mode
obligations.scope: Instrument health, dependency status, queue/projection/cursor lag, provider state, auth anomalies, data job failures, backup status, and incident acknowledgement without exposing sensitive payloads.

obligations.title: Backup, restore, projection rebuild, and disaster recovery
obligations.scope: Operate encrypted, policy-compliant backups and isolated restore/replay exercises that prove recovery point/time objectives, projection parity, document integrity, access control, and cutover readiness.

obligations.title: Performance, availability, and recovery-user experience
obligations.scope: Measure and enforce interactive command/read budgets, job progress, large-data behavior, slow/degraded dependency behavior, mobile rendering, and recoverable user-state copy.

obligations.title: Security, privacy, media safety, and least-privilege enforcement
obligations.scope: Implement defense-in-depth tenant policy, server authorization, secure session/request controls, encrypted storage, signed scoped files, malware scanning, webhook verification, egress controls, and secret-safe operations.

obligations.title: Full control/state accessibility and copy quality assurance
obligations.scope: Verify every mapped control, opened menu/form, individual field, validation, pending/error/provider state, accessible name, keyboard path, screen-reader announcement, and locale behavior against canonical anatomy/copy tables.

obligations.title: Tenant provisioning, intake, and empty-state onboarding
obligations.scope: Guide a newly provisioned tenant through owner verification, organization setup, catalogue/source intake, review, and honest empty states with no production demo data or fake operational readiness.

obligations.title: Guided operating readiness and supported activation
obligations.scope: Complete the tenant activation checklist across people, commercial/stock policy, roleplay, connection tests, legal/billing gates, training/support, and optional rails without treating a finished checklist as deployment authority.

obligations.title: Migration verification, cutover rehearsal, and tenant support recovery
obligations.scope: Migrate retained source and business records through review/report/reconciliation, rehearse rollback/compensation, and provide scoped support diagnostics with no unauthorized repair.

obligations.title: E188 physical interaction and release evidence
obligations.scope: Preserve one inset destination per list object, unvalued order projections, exact quantity/unit rows, atomic draft-and-apply Filters, and reachable phone keyboard/thumb navigation. Record browser-kit proof separately from Runtime/model/UI-embedded intelligence/Copilot execution; no E188 UI/UX item is deferred.

obligations.title: Release evidence board and full-system acceptance ledger
obligations.scope: Collect required contract, integration, end-to-end, accessibility, failure, recovery, performance, security, and operational evidence by task/control/state, reporting only verified scope.

obligations.title: Staged rollout, monitoring, rollback, and incident communications
obligations.scope: Prepare versioned deployment artifacts, safe rollout cohorts, monitored canary/rollback criteria, compensating migration path, operator ownership, and incident communication without self-authorizing production.

obligations.title: Production authorization and owner-go gate
obligations.scope: Require the recorded explicit owner authorization only after all evidence, operational ownership, recovery, security, accessibility, provider, billing, and tenant activation gates are satisfied.

obligations.title: Public documentation build and publication gate
obligations.scope: Generate the product documentation site solely from the public canonical allowlist and task graph, validate source hashes, links, task/control coverage, and keep internal historical material out of the published artifact.

obligations.title: Catalogue file-or-paste intake and reviewed source-item identity
obligations.scope: Provide one session-only file-or-pasted-text source surface and one ordered review queue, with literal SKU identity and locator plus a collective Product name/SKU/Unit readback and Include/Skip. Internal classification can persist only as a quiet later Product Sheet suggestion/default; no field mapping or per-row classification/artwork/source task precedes results, and raw source is never retained by Rocoto.

obligations.title: Reference classification, Internal category, Related products and reviewed enrichment
obligations.scope: Use the universal reference as a versioned classifier while retaining each coded SKU or accepted uncoded sale item’s literal identity, kind-appropriate independent facts, reviewable Internal category, reviewed direct RelatedItemLink through an inline existing-record picker, source evidence and review outcome. Ordinary intake never solicits relation candidates.

obligations.title: Catalogue navigation, search, and viewer preferences
obligations.scope: Serve tenant-authorized catalogue rows with tenant/source-order default plus optional Category and A–Z sorting, scoped search, explicit Related-products filter, archive visibility, exact catalogue-record navigation, intake-return context and viewer-only preferences.

obligations.title: Catalogue export formats and provenance
obligations.scope: Generate labelled house, standard, and augmented exports from retained sources and current authorized projections without pretending a derived file is the original import.

obligations.title: Large catalogue import/export performance and failure truth
obligations.scope: Move large parse, validation, source retention, and export work into bounded jobs with declared limits, progress, cancellation, retry, memory, and tenant-isolation evidence.

obligations.title: Inbound source envelope, retention, and quarantine
obligations.scope: Register an authorized external source envelope and transient fetch/scan/parse lifecycle; persist safe references/metadata and minimal derived business facts, never raw emails or incoming file bytes. WhatsApp is forward-only from accepted connection time and never supplies prior-history source data.

obligations.title: Source conversations, attachments, and product/email linkage
obligations.scope: Project authorized post-connection source threads and attachments with exact message/part linkage, readable provenance, access state, and related-object navigation for Customer, Product, and Albarán sheets; never project prior WhatsApp history.

obligations.title: Test, simulation, and fixture isolation
obligations.scope: Provide deterministic test and roleplay execution that uses namespaced tenant-safe fixtures, source lineage, reset rules, and no external transport or live provider success claim.

obligations.title: Inventory ledger, lots, allocation, and availability projections
obligations.scope: Build append-only receipt/count/adjustment/reservation/allocation/dispatch records and typed stock projections per tenant, SKU, location, unit, and lot.

obligations.title: Stock update utility command surface
obligations.scope: Ship the focused Receive stock and Record a stock count utility with exact labels, validation, review, recovery, permission, and return-to-SKU behavior rather than a generic stock edit.

obligations.title: New product utility
obligations.scope: Provide New product from toolbar, unknown-SKU, source, customer wording or order context. Add a product list accepts one file or pasted text into the same review queue, with no pre-result mapping, hidden SKU, placement, relation or commercial adoption.

obligations.title: Catalogue file-or-paste review-queue surface
obligations.scope: Provide a file drop or pasted product list, session-only custody, one ordered Excel/CSV review queue, explicit state/recovery and a collective readback where each row shows/edits only Product name/SKU/Unit plus Include/Skip. Internal classification can persist only as a quiet later Product Sheet suggestion/default. A selected PDF says Automatic PDF review · Ready to connect and Choose Excel or CSV, or paste the list; it is never stored, parsed or queued. No mapping screen or automatic relation appears before results.

obligations.title: Document rendering, revision, and print-ready artifact authority
obligations.scope: Render immutable issue/reprint artifacts from frozen order facts with versioned format/profile, exact page/sheet counts, audit, retention, and explicit file/print evidence.

obligations.title: Print queue, daily run, and printer-provider state
obligations.scope: Operate per-tenant print jobs for selected documents/day runs with ordered groups, clear job states, retry/cancel, provider receipts, and no claim of physical completion without evidence.

obligations.title: Export centre, output jobs, and download history
obligations.scope: Build date/revision-aware output selection, job creation, status, downloadable artifact history, export profile, and explicit source/format compatibility for daily files. Export Centre and day-level print/download shortcuts share one gallery-template → configured-saved-copy identity so category, product, salesperson, truck, date, page, layout and activity status cannot drift.

obligations.title: Document email, supplier forwarding, and ERP delivery state
obligations.scope: Deliver customer documents and related forwarding/export work through explicit authorized jobs with recipient, revision, schedule, provider receipt, failure, retry, and audit semantics.

obligations.title: Export utility command surface
obligations.scope: Provide the focused export utility with exact data scope, selected format, profile, retention, download state, accessibility labels, and honest partial/failed outcomes.

obligations.title: Tenant identity and membership boundary
obligations.scope: Create the authoritative tenant, member, role, sector, and lifecycle records that every protected read, command, file, job, and subscription resolves before domain work.

obligations.title: Authentication, session, and role-capability commands
obligations.scope: Implement sign-in, sign-out, session renewal, membership selection, role changes, revocation, and capability evaluation as server-enforced operations.

obligations.title: Actor, consent, and access-audit envelope
obligations.scope: Attach authenticated actor, tenant, request, causation, device/session, and declared test lineage to each protected operation without persisting credentials in business records.

obligations.title: Canonical record envelopes and identity lifecycle
obligations.scope: Establish durable IDs, revisions, archive/redaction rules, retained original identity, and explicit relationships for every system object before any projection is treated as canonical.

obligations.title: Event streams, folds, and replayable projections
obligations.scope: Build the event/outbox/projection spine so screens read tenant-authorized materialized facts and historical replay cannot import later knowledge into an earlier business state.

obligations.title: Command protocol, idempotency, and acknowledged outcomes
obligations.scope: Standardize command envelopes, validation, expected revision, idempotency lookup, typed errors, and acknowledgement semantics across every write path.

obligations.title: Schema expansion, backfill, and compensating recovery
obligations.scope: Make production schema change additive, observable, reversible by compensation where needed, and safe to roll forward during partial failure or a paused migration.

obligations.title: Realtime, offline drafts, and concurrent-edit recovery
obligations.scope: Deliver authorized projection notifications, cursor catch-up, constrained offline drafts, and server-resolved concurrent editing without treating presence as a lock.

obligations.title: Shared sheet, form, menu, and error-state contract
obligations.scope: Implement the reusable interaction boundary for Product, Customer, and Albarán sheets: one stable object ID, named layers, pending drafts, permission, loading, empty, error, conflict, archive, and recovery states.

obligations.title: Per-control exact-copy and accessible-name framework
obligations.scope: Bind canonical label tables to controls, tabs, menus, form fields, provider states, errors, and incomplete states so copy is precise, localized safely, and testable without altering business values.

obligations.title: Responsive and assistive interaction baseline
obligations.scope: Make the three sheet archetypes and all nested menus, tables, charts, forms, and status announcements usable with keyboard, screen reader, touch, and narrow viewport recovery.

obligations.title: Deterministic source parsing and exact-SKU candidate resolution
obligations.scope: Build the tier-zero parser for source wording, SKU candidates, unit/pack reconciliation, numeric ordering, attachment gating, and explicit unresolved output before any model or commercial command is considered.

obligations.title: Bounded reasoning, prediction, and constrained reply path
obligations.scope: Run approved intelligence only through versioned releases and authorized command/proposal envelopes, producing bounded finished-albarán predictions or reply drafts with evidence, alternatives, cost, and human/tenant grant policy.

obligations.title: Intelligence concerns, explanation, and human review lifecycle
obligations.scope: Specify observable scoped concern UI: one exact target, one red boundary, a concise dismissible reason, local re-evaluation after relevant edit or sent message, and retained disclosure history. Durable storage, model evaluation and learning remain later seams.

obligations.title: Interactive catalogue and variant intelligence
obligations.scope: Deliver an interactive, review-first catalogue intelligence surface for category feedback, variant interpretation, corrected descriptions, alternatives, and injection-safe conversation state.

obligations.title: Evaluation, replay, trace export, and error analysis
obligations.scope: Create consent/retention-eligible test sets, chronological replay, frozen release evaluation, metrics, error slices, trace export, and a release gate that reports uncertainty honestly.

obligations.title: Authorized backfill, correction learning, and model recovery
obligations.scope: Backfill approved source-to-record links and learning inputs through resumable, reviewable, tenant-safe jobs that preserve historical facts and never promote a correction merely because it repeats.

obligations.title: Illustration library, reference audit, and SKU association model
obligations.scope: Keep the approved image library, visual aliases, reference audit, asset checksum, source/license metadata, and SKU-owned association distinct from tenant catalogue identity and Internal-category/group or Related-products presentation.

obligations.title: Image candidate review, publication, and replacement recovery

obligations.title: Customer address, map, zone, and route controls

obligations.title: Customer source, relationship, and operational notices
